Analysis report
User guide

Select the LSA and NGS files, choose the primer barcode block used in the experiment, and select Run analysis. For structure mapping, use the mmCIF file and chain ID of the protein that was mutated. Both optional AlphaFold 3 JSON files must come from the same model as the structure.

The results ZIP contains QC for each well, variant summaries, reports, and the settings used for the run. Adding a structure also produces residue mapping tables, an SVG overview, and structure_explorer.html for offline 3D inspection. To try the workflow with four synthetic wells, select Run example.

Structure colors use signed ΔΔG. The most negative mapped residue is blue, zero is white, and the most positive is red. Raw energies and the selected substitutions are in the residue color CSV.
